# What does your average pawn loan really earn?

> Free pawn loan profit calculator for pawnbrokers: enter your rate, redemption rate, loan-to-value and what forfeits sell for to see profit per loan, break-even redemption, the largest loan an item can carry and the smallest loan worth writing. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
